article: Gitのローカルタグとリモートタグを削除する
scope: Compared the complete Japanese source and twelve translations, including command syntax, local/remote distinctions, warnings, links, dates, and article metadata.
findings: Removed duplicate future dates, retained original publication date 2022-10-02, and set lastmod to 2026-11-24 throughout the bundle.
Made the remote explicit in the listing command: git ls-remote --tags --refs origin. The --refs option avoids peeled pseudo-ref output for annotated tags.
Added a warning that deleting a remote tag does not automatically remove local copies held by collaborators and affects users of that remote.
Replaced the reference that could not be opened in this environment with official Git manuals for git-tag, git-ls-remote, and git-push in all locales.

post/gitでタグを消す/index.en.md.summary: Reviewed the complete translated procedure and commands, clarified local versus remote deletion, made the remote explicit during tag listing, added a collaborator-impact note, and replaced the inaccessible third-party reference with official Git documentation.

meaning.note: Compared the complete local-tag and remote-tag instructions in each translation. Confirmed that git tag -d removes the local tag, while git push origin --delete targets the named remote tag.

terminology.note: Checked local versus remote repository distinctions, tag name, origin remote, and command names. Replaced the tag-listing command with git ls-remote --tags --refs origin to make the remote explicit and list refs without peeled pseudo-refs.

mathematics.note: The procedural article contains no mathematical formulas or calculations.

code.note: Statically checked command syntax against the official Git manuals. Commands were not executed because the remote deletion command changes repository state.

links.note: Replaced the inaccessible third-party reference with official Git manuals for git-tag, git-ls-remote, and git-push; opened each official reference during review.

limitations: AI-assisted review; no human or native-speaker certification.
Commands were checked against documentation but not run; remote deletion is a state-changing operation.
